author: RabbitCake777
body:
MY ign is RabbitCake777

As you can see I am here for a Ban appeal. I believe i was falsely banned by a moderator. For a second i thought it was an accident. But it said i was banned for FLYING! I guess i was perm banned? Anyways, im not going to write much since I actually really didn't fly. Also as you can see my ign it was a friends account. I am not sure maybe he went on it and played. Im new to minecraft and i recently learned that their were hacks for this client. But i haven't use any of its hacks. I also do have terrible internet. Time Warner is terrible sometimes. I was banned after playing on a Nebula server. I really enjoy playing on this certain gamemode. Since it is mainly in the air (Most maps are in the sky) I believe i was lagging and i kept teleporting from my original spot to the spot where i was running at. Please i enjoy this server's gamemodes including THE WALLS AND especially NEBULA. I really hope i get excused for this ban since i dont recall hacking my whole life. I would glady come back on this server and happily with my friends play Nebula. Sorry to waste some of your personal time. But i believe this is worth reading for.
